data.description: Instead of a cone of electricity, an old or older time dragon can use its breath weapon to displace creatures in time. Each creature in the cone must succeed at a Will save (DC %1) or be shifted forward in time %2 rounds. For an affected creature, it's as if no time passed. Creatures that succeed at their saves are staggered for 1 round.
data.name: Shifting Breath
